title: Enabling the syscall_intercept library for RISC-V
problem: syscall_intercept library provides high-performance system call interception on x86, PowerPC, ARM but not RISC-V; missing functionality hinders RISC-V research and system development requiring syscall manipulation.
motivation: System call interception enables sandboxing, dynamic analysis, error injection testing, performance profiling. RISC-V tooling ecosystem incomplete without this capability; broader RISC-V adoption requires comprehensive tool support.
method: Port syscall_intercept to RISC-V Linux: design decisions for RISC-V architecture, implementation of user-space interception (no superuser required), evaluation on RISC-V systems.
key_novelty: First high-performance syscall_intercept implementation for RISC-V architecture.
contributions: Fills gap in RISC-V tooling ecosystem
Enables broader RISC-V adoption in research and system development
limitations: Use cases and applications not demonstrated
